title: Best Email Template Designers (2026): How to Hire One
description: How to hire an email template designer: what the package should include, how to brief it, testing, price factors and red flags.
intro: Email design covers the templates for your newsletters, promotions and automated emails. A good template looks right in many email apps, reads well on phones and is easy for you to reuse. Email design goes wrong when templates break in some apps, rely on images for important text, or cannot be edited in your email platform. This guide helps you order templates that work.

faq.q: Will the template work in my email platform?
faq.a: Ask the designer to build it in, or for, your platform, such as Mailchimp, Klaviyo or another tool. A design that only exists as an image cannot be sent as a real email.

faq.q: Why do emails look different in different apps?
faq.a: Email apps display code differently. Good designers test in common apps, including Gmail, Outlook and Apple Mail, on phone and desktop.
Keep important text as real text. Many people have images turned off, and screen readers cannot read text in images.

faq.q: Can I edit the template myself?
faq.a: Ask for editable sections for text, images and buttons, and a short guide on how to use them.

faq.q: Does the designer write the emails?
faq.a: Usually not. Email copywriting is often separate. Check what is included.
